entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return? I bought some shoes but the website is just so confusing, I couldn't figure out where to go.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, let me see... yes, it's VF88602. I just... I don't really understand what to do next.

No problem at all. I see the order here for the Mountain Bike Shoes. I can definitely guide you through this. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I don't know... I guess a fault? I wore them once and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I think it has something to do with the cleats, maybe they're positioned wrong? They just feel awful.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters. That's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. So, you're looking to get a refund for them?
Yes, please. I just want a refund. The policy page was so long, I got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just check the policy against your order date. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that you received the shoes 71 days ago. According to our knowledge base, all standard items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So it's okay? I can still send them back?

Yes, you are well within the return window. I can go ahead and authorize that return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. You can just print that out and attach it to the box.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried I was stuck with them.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that was it. Thank you for making it so easy.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
